title: Age of the Earlier Coverage's Coverage-Inactive Denial — Home Oxygen Therapy
content:
# Age of the Coverage-Inactive Denial — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** When a different coverage becomes primary for Home Oxygen Therapy, the first day of service found from the claim history replaces the effective date only when the most recent coverage-inactive denial from the earlier coverage was adjudicated no more than the window below before the confirmation. The earlier coverage is the coverage the oxygen record names; its class is read from the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records, and the denial's adjudication date from the oxygen claim history. Days are calendar days, counted as the later date less the earlier date. When the earlier coverage has no coverage-inactive denial on the oxygen claim history, the denial window is met. When the condition fails, the first day of service is the effective date.

| Class of the earlier coverage | Window (days before the confirmation) |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO, Commercial HMO | 180 |
| Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement Plan G | 120 |
| any other class (for example Medicare Advantage PPO, Medicare Advantage HMO, Medicaid Fee-for-Service) | 60 |

## Both sides (hypothetical)

| Earlier coverage class | Denial adjudicated, days before the confirmation | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO | 180 | met |
| Commercial PPO | 181 | fails |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 120 | met |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 121 | fails |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 60 | met |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 61 | fails |
| any class | no coverage-inactive denial on the claim history | met |
